_: kogaki#1349: the Move schema's field-to-role mapping. The pipeline reads roles, never field names (specs/spec-draft-pipeline/SPEC.md field-roles table). `required` roles must be mapped by every schema; `optional` roles are null (omitted here) where a schema has nothing to map them to. A field this file does not name is carried on the record and read by nothing.

shapes._: kogaki#1414: the shape of the two list-valued roles, both prose with no label set. Stated for people; tools/move_ingest.py enforces it on the paragraph path, and the role adapter never reads it. The Moves written before it are regenerated under it by kogaki#1415.
shapes.segments: one numbered line per Segment, in order: `<n>. does: <the step's operation, subject-free, never its effect on the reader>`, followed on every Segment after the first by ` — relation: <its relation to the Segment before it, in prose>`; Segment 1 carries no relation (kogaki#1411)
shapes.breaks: a list of prose tests, one `- <a specific change to the paragraph> — <what the reader loses>` line each, read whole; no keys and no fixed kinds
